card.name: After or when ending an instruction step
card.fires_on: The words "after" and "when" right after an action in a step-by-step instruction. They introduce a timing condition such as "after each sample" or "when you are done".

modes.label: after each repeated step
modes.description: "After" introduces a repeated or following action in preparation or procedure steps.
modes.example: Clear the duodenal lumen of the tube with an injection of air<< after>> each 15-minute sample collection.

modes.label: immediately after
modes.description: "After" follows "immediately" or "well" to say when to do the next step.
modes.example: Shake vigorously for 5 to 10 seconds immediately<< after>> adding the water.

modes.label: when done
modes.description: "when" ends an instruction and points to the user finishing something.
modes.example: Click on Next<< when>> you are done.

card.plain: It marks the little word "after" or "when" that tells you when to do the next step.
